svg.aria-label: Dana Pensiun details: migrated a legacy VDOS financial system to Laravel; built ledger, journal, cash and bank, reporting and reconciliation modules; worked in 1 to 2 week sprints with finance stakeholders; tested at unit, integration and UAT level. Self-reported: about 30 to 40 percent better operational efficiency and 25 to 30 percent fewer manual input errors.

svg.text: Migrated a legacy VDOS-based financial system to Laravel
Built General Ledger, Journal Processing, Cash & Bank, Financial Reporting and Balance Reconciliation
Turned accounting workflows into features with finance stakeholders, in 1 to 2 week sprints
Tested at unit, integration and UAT level before releases
About 30 to 40% better operational efficiency and 25 to 30% fewer manual input errors
